title: fix(sse): ensure correct token/event ordering and delimiter framing in SSE streaming
author: Ava Chen
description: Fixes a class of SSE streaming framing bugs causing partial JSON payloads and out-of-order token/event emissions when chunk boundaries align with delimiter tokens. Root cause: the streamer state machine allowed token events (token/text) to be emitted before final delimiter events in edge chunk splits, and the framing layer occasionally emitted an extra newline delimiter when an internal buffer boundary coincided with a partial JSON object. This PR standardizes the emitter ordering, introduces a two-phase flush for partial JSON frames, and ensures we never emit delimiter-only events ahead of token events for a single logical message. Motivation: customer incidents and internal fuzzing found reproducible corruption in function-calling structured outputs and OpenAI-compat streaming where tools received truncated JSON objects. The change improves compatibility for tool/function-calling flows and structured output consumers using the OpenAI compatibility layer. Implementation summary: 1) rework sse/emitter to guarantee token events are sequenced before delimiter/finish events for the same message id; 2) add a small frameheader byte to internal buffer boundaries to avoid accidental extra delimiters; 3) introduce a ReassemblyBuffer that reconstructs partial JSON frames and only emits parsed objects or well-formed partial-json tokens; 4) add defensive validation in the openai-compat adapter to drop isolated delimiter-only events and retry on the next token; 5) update metrics/tracing to attribute bad-framing counts and expose diagnostic spans for root-cause analysis. Backwards compatibility: API surface unchanged; behavior only fixes ordering and reduces corrupted partial JSONs. Rollout plan: gradual canary on streaming endpoints with a 24-hour quick rollback on observed regression, followed by fleet rollout once canary errors drop below 0.1% for 48h. Tests: unit tests for ordering, property-based fuzz tests for chunk boundaries, integration tests with tool-calling examples, and e2e test with OpenAI-compat client. Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] fuzz harness updated, [x] integration tests, [x] metrics, [x] canary rollout plan, [x] docs note in release notes. References: internal incident INC-2026-08, ENG-1427, test vectors in tests/sse/fixtures/partial-json-edges.json.
